title: Set pipe clamp spacing from the installed vibration spectrum (generic)
summary: Clamp spacing set from static loads alone can lead to fatigue of rigid pipework.
what_happened: Generic: fatigue indications on rigid pipework adjacent to clamps after first running.
root_cause: Installed vibration spectrum not used for clamp spacing.
recommendation: Require installed-spectrum evidence, or an agreed conservative envelope, before accepting clamp spacing.
applicability: Rigid pipework supported by clamps in vibration zones.

origin.source_ref: Promotion of a project lesson (project data removed)
